---
title: Publish a skill
description: Share a local behavior with your team, and keep it current.
sidebar_label: Publish
---

Publishing takes a directory you already have and gives it one identity, one
version history, and one movable current version.

## Publish

```sh title="Publish from a directory"
topos publish ./skills/code-review --yes
```

### What the receipt tells you

A publish prints what changed and how to undo it. Read the receipt before you
publish again.

<Note>
  A version is the hash of its bytes, so what you pin is exactly what you get.
</Note>
